item.text: {"question_id":"5B.1","answer":"For 2023, Tshisekedi’s stated agenda and budget priorities were broadly oriented toward public prosperity: macroeconomic stability, education, health coverage, employment, agriculture, infrastructure, diversification, and poverty reduction (BATCH-0013-E007; BATCH-0023-E013). Within the period, the PDL-145T had moved beyond announcement into reported construction and procurement: government agencies said works had begun on schools, health centres, administrative buildings, and related infrastructure, although delivery projections and execution claims were not independently verified (BATCH-0023-E001; BATCH-0006-E010). The United Nations also reported continued 2023 implementation of the programme to expand basic services, local resilience, and local institutions, while noting substantial partner involvement and providing no executed expenditure, completion-rate, quality, or distributional evidence (BATCH-0010-E004). Presidential monitoring reported that free primary education had been implemented, but acknowledged difficulties in implementing universal health coverage and free maternity care (BATCH-0020-E012). These are material indications of prosperity-oriented policy and some implementation, but they do not establish broad, high-quality, or sustainable welfare gains. The 2023 World Bank economic memorandum found that growth under the existing macroeconomic framework would not improve living conditions without ambitious reforms (BATCH-0016-E013), while 25.8 million people faced crisis or emergency food insecurity during the year, a national outcome not attributable solely to Tshisekedi (BATCH-0020-E003). Sustainability concerns are also relevant context, though the underlying oil auction occurred in 2022: UNESCO’s 2023 decision strongly regretted the inclusion of blocks overlapping Virunga and urged cancellation, without establishing Tshisekedi’s personal responsibility or subsequent implementation (BATCH-0001-E011; BATCH-0014-E007). Overall, the 2023 evidence supports prosperity-oriented intent and reported partial implementation, but leaves executed-budget performance, independent outcome verification, rent-seeking controls, household distribution, and long-term sustainability materially
